result.question: What did the employer named in this claim itself say about AI and its job cuts? Return its records with the verbatim quote and source. Claim: monday.com laid off 20% of its staff because AI replaced them
result.explanation: Returns all employer claim records for monday.com with the verbatim AI quote and source URL.
result.sql: SELECT record_id, company, event_date, jobs_cut, jobs_cut_text, ai_attribution, ai_quote, source_url FROM seismo_pg.v_employer_claims WHERE lower(company) LIKE '%monday.com%' LIMIT 50

rows.jobs_cut_text: approximately 20% of the Company's current workforce
rows.ai_quote: On July 22, 2026, the Company announced a restructuring plan (the "2026 Restructuring Plan") designed to align its organizational structure with its strategic focus on the AI Work Platform, support a leaner operating model, and accelerate investment in its AI-driven growth strategy.

result.note: Rows come straight from the published record through Zetaris; the model only wrote the query.
result.claim: monday.com laid off 20% of its staff because AI replaced them
result.how_to_read: The rows are the employer's own words from its filing. If no row is returned, the published record holds nothing from this employer that supports the claim.
